name: VOD To Plex
description: Dispatcharr plugin that bridges VOD movies into Plex via rclone HTTP mount with 302 redirect streaming, web dashboard, and selective activation.
author: knmplace

fields.label: Dispatcharr
fields.description: Connection to Dispatcharr for VOD proxy streaming.

fields.label: Dispatcharr URL
fields.help_text: Full URL of Dispatcharr reachable by Plex (LAN IP, not localhost), including the port (e.g. http://192.168.1.x:9191). Used for 302 redirect playback and for resolving Dispatcharr's proxy redirects during audio probing — a URL missing its port will silently break both. Use 127.0.0.1 if running on same host.

fields.label: HTTP Server
fields.description: The plugin runs its own HTTP server for the dashboard UI and rclone/Plex streaming endpoint.

fields.label: Dashboard / Streaming Port
fields.help_text: Port for the web dashboard and VOD streaming endpoint. Must be exposed in Docker.

fields.label: Dashboard Host IP
fields.help_text: LAN IP of the Docker host (not the container). Used for dashboard URL and STRM file URLs.

fields.label: Plex Integration
fields.description: Connect to your Plex server to manage the VOD library and monitor playback.

fields.label: Plex URL
fields.help_text: Full URL of your Plex server (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:32400)

fields.label: Plex Token
fields.help_text: X-Plex-Token for authenticating with Plex API

fields.label: Plex Library Section ID
fields.help_text: The Plex library section number for VOD movies (find via Plex API /library/sections)

fields.label: STRM Files
fields.description: Configure where STRM and NFO files are written for Plex to discover.

fields.label: STRM Output Directory
fields.help_text: Directory where .strm and .nfo files are written. Should be accessible to Plex via rclone mount or shared volume.

fields.label: Streaming
fields.description: Playback uses 302 redirect to Dispatcharr's native VOD proxy. No streaming configuration needed — Dispatcharr handles connections, Range requests, and session management.

fields.label: Debug: Log Connections & Server Errors
fields.help_text: Logs server start/stop errors and every connection to/from Dispatcharr and Plex (inbound VOD requests, outbound Plex API calls, redirect resolution) to the dashboard's Logs tab. Useful for diagnosing setup issues remotely. Generates a lot of log entries — leave off unless troubleshooting.

fields.label: Max Concurrent Connections Per Title
fields.help_text: Caps how many simultaneous real Dispatcharr VOD connections a single movie or episode can hold. rclone's VFS mount can re-open a file's stream several times over the course of one watch (not just a millisecond read-ahead burst) — each open is a separate real provider connection unless capped here. Extra sessions beyond the limit are force-dropped, keeping the most recently active ones, both when a new stream is requested AND on an ongoing ~10s background sweep (so connections opened outside the normal redirect flow, e.g. rclone re-hitting an already-issued redirect URL directly, still get caught). Set too high (or 0 to disable) relative to what your IPTV provider actually allows and you WILL hammer their concurrent-connection limit — most providers cap total simultaneous streams per account (commonly 1-3), and every activated title sharing that account competes for the same pool, so this should generally match or sit under your provider's per-account connection limit, not just what feels reasonable for one show.

fields.label: Maintenance
fields.description: Background checks that keep the activated library in sync with Dispatcharr's VOD catalog.

fields.label: Removed-Movie Check Interval (seconds)
fields.help_text: How often the plugin checks whether activated movies still exist in Dispatcharr's catalog (e.g. after an M3U account refresh removes them). Cleans up orphaned STRM files and stale Plex entries. Minimum 10 seconds.

fields.label: Auto Stream Refresh Interval (days)
fields.help_text: How often each activated movie's cached provider pick is automatically cleared so the next play re-resolves fresh (light touch only — no STRM/Plex changes, movies currently playing are skipped). Set to 0 to disable. Use the dashboard's Refresh/Reactivate buttons for an on-demand or full fix.

fields.label: Language Detection
fields.description: Optional. Enter a TMDB API key to enable looking up each movie's original language. Leave blank to disable this feature entirely.

fields.label: TMDB API Key (v3)
fields.help_text: TMDB v3 API key. Used for language lookups. Either this or the Read Access Token is required.

fields.label: TMDB Read Access Token
fields.help_text: TMDB API Read Access Token (Bearer). Takes priority over v3 API key if both are set.

actions.label: Open Dashboard
actions.description: Open the VOD To Plex web dashboard in a new tab.

actions.label: Start Server
actions.description: Start the HTTP server for the dashboard and streaming endpoint.

confirm.message: This will stop the dashboard and streaming endpoint. Active streams will be interrupted. Continue?

actions.label: Server Status
actions.description: Check the current status of the HTTP server.
